headline: Global Banking & Markets: African Leadership Prize Awarded to Edoh Kossi Amenounvé, CEO of the BRVM
summary: On 15 November 2026 in Kigali, the Global Banking & Markets Awards Africa presented Edoh Kossi Amenounvé, Director General of the BRVM, with a prize. It recognized his contribution to financial services.
why: The BRVM is the regional securities exchange of West African Economic and Monetary Union countries, linking capital markets across several francophone African economies.
